posts.author: OmlyUltra
posts.body:
Hello everyone!
I'm Omly, and I picked up RPG Maker MZ last month after being inspired to do some solo development in my off time. I work as a game designer, having been fortunate enough to find employment in the industry after I graduated, but working in design meant that I didn't get as much of a chance to interact with the other aspects of development that I was interested in (given, I suck at these other aspects).
RPG Maker felt like the perfect choice for me to try my hand at making something, well, anything. I missed the feeling of making a game for the sake of making a game, and ever since I've picked up the engine I've been much more fulfilled.
I started off a project the day I got the engine as a combat prototype for a system I had in my brain at the time, and before I knew it, it had become way more. After about a month of grinding away at it, I ended up releasing a demo of my game Soulstealer on itch.io about 3 weeks ago, which was the first time I ever released anything on my own (it was incredibly nerve-wracking!!!). But now I'm hooked >
I'm really excited to continue to work on my project, as well as learn from everyone on the forum. I am very happy to meet everyone! I love discussing game design, especially gameplay systems, but am more than happy to talk about anything I can contribute to!
